region_sum_screening_scope: All nonnegative finite numeric arrays named region_common_mm3, common_mm3, or commons_mm3 in each complete job JSON, plus explicit STOP pin/remainder and simultaneous PAWL/shoulder cover partition recombinations. Different physical pairs, pose samples, and sequential nut route legs are not summed together.
original_rule: Every individual region common is at most 1e-7 mm^3.
revalidated_rule: The sum of all nonnegative region common volumes is at most the unchanged 1e-7 mm^3 tolerance; this upper-bounds the material union intersection.
